assessment.reason: Recent volume supports the direction, but protection uncertainty materially affects its resilience.
assessment.model_case: 38 and 55 attempts support expected regular usage. Career blending gives 36.67, already above 32.5; defense lifts it to 42.17. Raw probability exceeds the fitted range and becomes the calibration ceiling, overstating certainty.
assessment.price_case: This is BetMGM's main line, with four exact-line peers. Consensus is below required break-even; model value requires sustained elevated volume, not necessarily the full defensive uplift.
assessment.context_case: Receiver and tackle concerns could reduce sustained drives or increase catch-up passing; net impact is uncertain.
blocking_checks: Resolve Brown's availability and protection plan: further protection weakness could undermine the elevated-volume assumption.

qualitative_review.countercase: Career volume is below the line, and offensive disruption could outweigh pass-heavy game script.
open_checks: Recheck the roughly 44-minute-old price and settlement rules.

assessment.reason: A likely under is not necessarily attractive at -240; the low projection rests on a truncated debut.
assessment.model_case: Five attempts reduce career volume to 26.03; three completions determine unshrunk completion rate and depress yards per completion. Mean stages are 149.82, 153.99 after defense, then 144.75 after venue. Raw probability exceeds the fitted range and reaches the calibration ceiling.
assessment.price_case: 243.5 is an alternate above the 213.5 main quote; the ladder charges progressively more for cushion. Single-book exact-line consensus is below break-even. The labeled hypothetical requires a mean below 204.82, not merely below 243.5.
assessment.context_case: Reported role resumption contradicts extrapolating the shortened debut into normal workload.

qualitative_review.countercase: The alternate cushion helps, but a restored workload can make its expensive price unattractive.
open_checks: Check final active status, not the already reported planned role.
